machine.description: Stable machine ID from the local configuration.

owner_approval_ref.description: A local reference to the owner's approval for high-trust modes. Never put a password, token, or secret here.

private_details.description: Registrar-only context. The board renderer omits this field.

proposed_priority.description: A proposal only. The registrar sets effective_priority during approval.

public_title.description: Sanitized text safe to show on a board or status display. Never put credentials, private URLs, health details, or client details here.

requester.description: Stable seat ID from the local configuration. Display names belong in config, not in requests.
